CustomField.description: When the work order reached Completed or Closed. Stamped automatically by the Work Order Touch Sync before-save flow the first time Status becomes Completed or Closed; feeds Hours_Open__c and Resolution_Days__c. Replaces Completed_Date__c, whose _Date suffix asserted a date-only type it never had - this field stores date AND time, per ARCHITECTURE.md §1 rule 9.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date AND time the work is finished. Stamped automatically when Status first becomes Completed or Closed - do not set it by hand; resolution time is measured from Reported DateTime to this value.
CustomField.label: Completed DateTime
